speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies. The intense nocturnal itching, the presence of red bumps (burrows), your recent travel to a high-risk environment (Miami), and normal eosinophil counts are classic indicators of a Sarcoptes scabiei infestation rather than a systemic allergic reaction or other parasitic disease.
